channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Pascal Siakam | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Pascal Siakam from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Channing Frye on Kyle Lowry, Kawhi Leonard, Nick Nurse, Joel Embiid, Jaylen Brown, Pascal Siakam, OG Anunoby, Tyrese Maxey, VJ Edgecombe
item.description:
Channing Frye:

“Nick Nurse, one thing that's not taking into consideration is Nick Nurse is a beast. And so when you add all these personalities to a team, Joel Embiid, Tyrese Maxey, you know, Bron, VJ Edgecombe, you know, Jaylen Brown, you need a coach that can handle all that that's going to put them in the right situation. A lot of them, everyone's going to talk about usage rate, but Nick Nurse made it work in Toronto with, you know, OG Anunoby, Pascal Siakam, Kyle Lowry and Kawhi Leonard.”

Channing Frye on Kyle Lowry, Kawhi Leonard, Nick Nurse, Joel Embiid, Jaylen Brown, Pascal Siakam, OG Anunoby, Tyrese Maxey, VJ Edgecombe, Jul 28, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Jeremy Lin on Kyle Lowry, Danny Green, Marc Gasol, Serge Ibaka, Kawhi Leonard, Jodie Meeks, Pascal Siakam, Fred VanVleet
item.description:
“I had Jodie Meeks, Norm Powell, Fred VanVleet, Marc Gasol, Serge Ibaka, Kyle Lowry, Kawhi Leonard, Pascal Siakam and Danny Green. I learned a lot from those guys. I learned so much being out.”

Jeremy Lin on Kyle Lowry, Danny Green, Marc Gasol, Serge Ibaka, Kawhi Leonard, Jodie Meeks, Pascal Siakam, Fred VanVleet, May 28, 2026. Source: New York Times.

item.title: Myles Turner on Pascal Siakam, Tyrese Haliburton
item.description:
Myles Turner:

“I couldn’t tell Tyrese, Pascal, Obi, TJ, or any of those guys what was really going on at the time because, one, it’s basically a breach when you’re in active negotiations. And two, I couldn’t show my hand. If I told them what was up, then all of a sudden it gets back to the front office like, ‘Oh, Myles, you’ve got this going on,’ and that could mess up my whole free-agency process. And mind you, this was my first time ever being a free agent—an unrestricted free agent. So I had to cherish that opportunity to choose, and I was going to take full advantage of it.”

Myles Turner on Pascal Siakam, Tyrese Haliburton, Mar 21, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Pascal Siakam
item.description:
Oh No He Didn't: Rick Carlisle:

“I'm so happy for our players. The last month has really been so challenging in so many ways. Pascal Siakam is one of the favorite players I've ever been around at any level”

Rick Carlisle on Pascal Siakam, Jan 8, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Brandon Ingram on Pascal Siakam
item.description:
Brandon Ingram on going at Pascal Siakam in crunch time:

“I knew he was in foul trouble and I knew he didn’t want to be overly aggressive, so he was at my mercy at that point.”

Brandon Ingram on Pascal Siakam, Nov 26, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Tyrese Haliburton on Pascal Siakam
item.description:
“I was really hoping they would call a timeout, but we had to get back out on defense. That’s a special moment especially because we are always getting on Pascal for not dunking anymore. That was cool to see.“Honestly, me and Pascal have not spoken about this play yet. I don’t know if we will until this is over. But, definitely a lot of fun, and if we are fortunate enough to go on and win this thing, I think that play will be remembered for a long time.”

Tyrese Haliburton on Pascal Siakam, Jun 20, 2025. Source: New York Times.

item.title: Ja Morant on Pascal Siakam, Shai Gilgeous-Alexander, Jalen Williams
item.description:
“Instead of focusing on the performances we seen from Jdub/Shai [Jalen Williams and Shai Gilgeous-Alexander], Tj/Siakam [T.J. McConnell and Pascal Siakam], how this series is going,”

Ja Morant on Pascal Siakam, Shai Gilgeous-Alexander, Jalen Williams, Jun 17, 2025. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Pascal Siakam
item.description:
head coach Rick Carlisle said.

“Getting Tyrese made it very clear what our identity as a team needed to be. We needed to be a fast-paced team with shooting, and we had some good shooting at the time. “The Siakam trade took things to another level.”

Rick Carlisle on Pascal Siakam, Jun 1, 2025. Source: New York Times.

item.title: Tom Thibodeau on Pascal Siakam
item.description:
Thibs on Siakam winning ECF MVP:

“He's a very gifted player, played a terrific series and I think the versatility, his ability to run the floor, play in the paint, face the basket, put it on the floor. He's a tough cover. Sometimes you can play him well, and because of his size and his release, it's still a good shot.”

Tom Thibodeau on Pascal Siakam, May 31, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Pascal Siakam
item.description:
Pacers coach Rick Carlisle said.

“The thing that I admire about Pascal is he understands when to interject at the right times and the appropriate times. It’s not like some constant voice or anything like that. There’s an art to great leadership. It's something that is learned certainly at a lot of levels, but he’s just had a natural feel for it. He’s got a lot of experience and the guys respect him.”

Rick Carlisle on Pascal Siakam, Apr 29, 2025. Source: Indianapolis Star.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Pascal Siakam
item.description:
Rick Carlisle on Pascal Siakam:

“He's a great person and he's really taken on a leadership role... He's immersed himself in our team, he's become a big part of our culture and we really love having him here.”

Rick Carlisle on Pascal Siakam, Nov 18, 2024. Source: x.com.

item.title: Kevin Pritchard on Pascal Siakam
item.description:
“We've signed Siakam to a four-year max deal. We had a pretty quick negotiation. This was a top priority,”

Kevin Pritchard on Pascal Siakam, Jul 8, 2024. Source: Twitter @TonyREast.

item.title: Tyrese Haliburton on Pascal Siakam
item.description:
“I'm going to do everything in my power to make sure Pascal Siakam is in a Pacers uniform next year,”

Tyrese Haliburton on Pascal Siakam, May 28, 2024. Source: Twitter @TonyREast.

item.title: Obi Toppin on Pascal Siakam
item.description:
“I feel like Siakam coming here was a big thing for us just because of the experience that he has,”

Obi Toppin on Pascal Siakam, May 2, 2024. Source: Twitter @TonyREast.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Pascal Siakam, Jarace Walker, Aaron Nesmith, Bennedict Mathurin, Ben Sheppard
item.description:
Dustin Dopirak:Carlisle:

“Aaron Nesmith and Pascal Siakam are great examples for Jarace Walker, Ben Sheppard, Ben Mathurin.... Pascal has earned his position in this league, two-time All-Star, two-time All-NBA. Aaron Nesmith has earned his spot on our team.”

Rick Carlisle on Pascal Siakam, Jarace Walker, Aaron Nesmith, Bennedict Mathurin, Ben Sheppard, Jan 26, 2024. Source: Twitter @DustinDopirak.

item.title: Jakob Poeltl on Pascal Siakam
item.description:
Poeltl on the Siakam trade:

“It was tough because he was the guy I was closest to on this team… I guess I was mentally prepared for it a little bit already because there were so many rumours… but it’s still really sad for me to basically lose my best friend on the team”

Jakob Poeltl on Pascal Siakam, Jan 25, 2024. Source: Twitter @JLew1050.

item.title: Myles Turner on Pascal Siakam
item.description:
Scott Agness:Myles Turner on Pascal Siakam:

“He's shown what he can do. He's a great iso player. He sees the floor well,had a triple-double tonight, plays with a lot of passion and energy and fits right into our mold.”

Myles Turner on Pascal Siakam, Jan 25, 2024. Source: Twitter @ScottAgness.

item.title: Nick Nurse on Pascal Siakam
item.description:
Dustin Dopirak:Nick Nurse on Pascal Siakam:

“He was such an interesting prospect when he arrived. So full of energy and speed and awesome love of the game.... Came in as a rookie and just was playing so hard.”

Nick Nurse on Pascal Siakam, Jan 25, 2024. Source: Twitter @DustinDopirak.

item.title: Nick Nurse on Pascal Siakam
item.description:
Dustin Dopirak:Nick Nurse on playing against Pascal Siakam:

“I told O.G. he looked funny in blue. I'll probably tell Pascal the same.”

Nick Nurse on Pascal Siakam, Jan 25, 2024. Source: Twitter @DustinDopirak.

item.title: Masai Ujiri on Pascal Siakam
item.description:
Ujiri on Siakam managing trade/contract rumours:

“He handled it perfectly. I give him 100 out of 100. It has to be difficult, and I said that to him... Nothing stopped him from coming to work everyday & trying to be the best he could be while he performed. We truly respect that.”

Masai Ujiri on Pascal Siakam, Jan 18, 2024. Source: Twitter @JLew1050.

item.title: Masai Ujiri on Pascal Siakam
item.description:
Ujiri on his relationship with Siakam:

“I think the lines of communication in the summer were not that great. That part I'm not particularly proud of.”

Masai Ujiri on Pascal Siakam, Jan 18, 2024. Source: Twitter @JLew1050.

item.title: Masai Ujiri on Pascal Siakam, OG Anunoby
item.description:
Ujiri on the decision to pivot, trade Anunoby/Siakam and go younger:

“The uncertainty of free agency was a big factor. We also looked at the trend of the team. We tried to give it as much time as we can.”

Masai Ujiri on Pascal Siakam, OG Anunoby, Jan 18, 2024. Source: Twitter @JLew1050.

item.title: Masai Ujiri on Pascal Siakam
item.description:
Ujiri on the return in the Siakam trade:

“This is what was there for us. We measured it with what was there for us in the past and it was consistent and so we decided to move on it.”

Masai Ujiri on Pascal Siakam, Jan 18, 2024. Source: Twitter @JLew1050.

item.title: Kyle Lowry on Pascal Siakam
item.description:
Kyle Lowry on Siakam traderumours:

“Pascal, my beloved one, is one of the most coveted players in our league, he’s one of the most talented players in our league and whatever happens with him he’ll be successful. I’m always going to love him and support him and be happy for him”

Kyle Lowry on Pascal Siakam, Jan 17, 2024. Source: Twitter @JLew1050.

item.title: Masai Ujiri on Pascal Siakam
item.description:
Masai Ujiri on not initiating extension talks with Pascal Siakam:

“A lot of players didn't play the right way. I said it, that we were selfish, I'm not running away from that. We were selfish and we didn't play the right way. So let us see it when we play the right way.”

Masai Ujiri on Pascal Siakam, Oct 2, 2023. Source: Twitter @michaelgrange.

item.title: Paul Reed on Nick Nurse, Pascal Siakam
item.description:
Paul Reed:

“I’ve talked to him [Nick Nurse] plenty of times and it’s always been kind of the same kind of idea. He talked about molding me into a Pascal Siakam-type player. Somebody who can kind of do it all. Shoot the ball, drive, pass, but right now, it’s all about focusing on my shot mechanics. That’s the start. That’s where it starts at.”

Paul Reed on Nick Nurse, Pascal Siakam, Jul 25, 2023. Source: Sixers Wire.

item.title: Michael Grange on Pascal Siakam
item.description:
Michael Grange on Pascal Siakam:

“He's been a guy I think around the NBA is known to be available for the right offer. And doesn't mean he's gonna get traded.”

Michael Grange on Pascal Siakam, Jul 12, 2023. Source: Apple Podcasts.

item.title: Justin Champagnie on Pascal Siakam
item.description:
Champagnie on facing #Raptors:

“I'm always excited for an opportunity to step on the court ... my experience in Toronto was pretty good. I'm really close with some of those guys. Pascal is like an older brother to me. I learned a lot. Looking forward to playing against them.”

Justin Champagnie on Pascal Siakam, Apr 7, 2023. Source: Twitter @RealBobManning.

item.title: Scottie Barnes on Pascal Siakam
item.description:
Josh Lewenberg:Scottie Barnes on his 360:

“I remember the last game when I was out I think either OG or Pascal had a fast-break dunk and I said 'Do something, that was weak.'They did like a simple 1-handed dunk. So when I got it that automatically came to mind and I was like, I've gotta do something”

Scottie Barnes on Pascal Siakam, Mar 27, 2023. Source: Twitter @JLew1050.

item.title: Khem Birch on Pascal Siakam
item.description:
Khem Birch on Pascal Siakam's work ethic and season:

“When he wakes up in the morning, I don’t even think he eats breakfast or stretches. He works out for hours before practice, practises, and then works out for another hour after practice. I’ve never seen anything like it..”

Khem Birch on Pascal Siakam, Sep 30, 2022. Source: Twitter.
